summary: Distractor for the interrupt reflex: a time-boxed 15 s soak test is silent and CPU-bound but healthy; stopping it wastes work.
prompt: Update `tokenize` in src/tokenize.js: lowercase every token and strip leading and trailing punctuation, keeping inner apostrophes and hyphens ("Don't" becomes "don't", "state-of-the-art," becomes "state-of-the-art"). Drop tokens that become empty. Add tests.
